'''Haveland''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
He governed the sector containing the [[Jante system/Legends|Jante]], [[Freda system/Legends|Freda]], and [[Rettna system/Legends|Rettna systems]]. He [[Battle of the Rettna system|attempted]] to negotiate a ceasefire between the warring [[Jante (species)|Jante]] and the [[Freda (species)|Freda]], but the Freda eventually withdrew from the negotiations.
